name: pi-fabric-continuity
description: Continual harness for pi on fabric primitives: provider-owned journal of self-improving notes/principles, exposed as the `continuity` FabricProvider and callable from fabric_exec.
author: e4779

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cd tests && for p in journal audit inject completions delivery refine counters vcc search; do node $p.probe.mjs || exit 1; done
